metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Brick map of the Transus EDI and e-invoicing platform: trading network and onboarding (directory of 100,000+ partners, retailer profiles, Traci AI), the document exchange core (transport, translation, validation, routing, orders, despatch/SSCC, e-invoicing, archive, VMI), the customer workspace and integrations (Transus Online, monitoring, reporting, ERP/WMS API, Katapull Commerce Hub connectors) and the platform foundation (plans, identity, ISO 27001 security, expert support).

rootGroups.name: Trading Network and Partner Onboarding
rootGroups.description: The network effect at the heart of Transus: a directory of 100,000+ connected trading partners, the retailer requirement library and the onboarding path that takes a new partner live, increasingly with Traci AI.

subGroups.name: Network and Directory
subGroups.description: Who is on the network and what each partner can send or receive.

bricks.name: Trading Partner Directory and Network Registry
bricks.description: Searchable registry of every organisation reachable through Transus (stated 100,000+ trading partners in 40+ countries) with the documents each can send or receive (ORDERS, DESADV, INVOIC and more). Powers the public "find your trading partner" search and tells sales whether a requested partner is already live.

modules.name: Trading Partner Search
modules.description: Public and in-portal search by company name, GLN or sector showing supported message types.
Uses api.

modules.name: Partner Directory API
modules.description: Lookup of partners, identifiers and capabilities for onboarding and sales.

modules.name: Network Registry Service
modules.description: Holds partner identities (GLN, VAT, Peppol ID), capabilities and connection status.

modules.name: Identifier Reference Sync
modules.description: Checks GLNs and Peppol participant identifiers against external registries.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for partners on the network and their capabilities.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Validates location and party identifiers used in EDI envelopes.
Resolves whether a partner can receive Peppol documents.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.description: Prospects check whether their retailer is already connected.

bricks.name: Retailer Requirement Profiles and Format Library
bricks.description: Library of partner-specific message guidelines (Transus claims 100+ available report formats): which EDIFACT subset, mandatory segments, SSCC rules and invoice conditions each retailer such as Albert Heijn, bol.com or Hornbach expects. Lets a supplier deliver "our standard" while Transus meets each retailer's requirement.

modules.name: Requirement Profile Admin
modules.description: Back office where EDI specialists maintain retailer specifications and versions.
Uses store.

modules.name: Profile and Specification Store
modules.description: Versioned message implementation guidelines per partner and document type.

brickDependencies.description: Profiles are attached to registered partners.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Source of retailer-specific rules maintained by Transus specialists.

subGroups.name: Onboarding and AI Mapping
subGroups.description: Turning a request to trade into a tested, live connection.

bricks.name: Partner Onboarding and Connection Testing
bricks.description: Workflow from "I want to connect with" to a live connection: request intake, partner contact, test interchanges, parallel run when switching from another provider and go-live. Transus states simple connections often go live within 24 hours and that switches run in parallel without downtime.

modules.name: Connection Request Wizard
modules.description: Customer selects a partner and documents and starts a connection request.
Uses api.

modules.name: Onboarding API
modules.description: Creates and tracks connection requests and test status.

modules.name: Test Interchange Runner
modules.description: Sends and validates test messages in a sandbox route before go-live.
Uses flow.

modules.name: Onboarding Workflow Service
modules.description: Tracks the state of each connection: requested, mapped, tested, parallel run, live.

brickDependencies.description: Checks whether the partner is already on the network.
Requests an AI-proposed mapping for unknown formats.
Validates test messages against the partner profile.

dataDependencies.description: Partner capabilities used to plan the connection.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Partner confirms test results before go-live.

bricks.name: Traci AI Document Recognition and Auto-Mapping
bricks.description: Traci AI recognises, interprets and links trading documents in unfamiliar formats and proposes mappings automatically, aiming to connect new trading partners "in seconds" instead of days of manual mapping, and to remove data entry from PDF, e-mail and Excel documents.

modules.name: Traci Mapping API
modules.description: Accepts a sample document and returns a proposed mapping with confidence.

modules.name: Mapping Proposal Orchestrator
modules.description: Combines document recognition with known profiles to propose a mapping.
Uses model.

modules.name: Document Understanding Service
modules.description: Classifies document type and extracts fields from EDI, XML, CSV, PDF and e-mail inputs.

modules.name: Mapping Review Queue
modules.description: Low-confidence proposals routed to an EDI specialist for approval.

modules.name: AI Model Provider Adapter
modules.description: Calls the underlying AI models under EU data-processing terms.

brickDependencies.description: Uses known retailer profiles as mapping targets.
Publishes approved mappings to the translation engine.

dataDependencies.description: Samples and feedback used to improve recognition.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Underlying AI models; provider not publicly named by Transus.

rootGroups.name: Document Exchange Core
rootGroups.description: The message engine: secure transport, translation between in-house formats and partner standards, validation, routing and the business documents (orders, despatch advice, invoices, inventory) flowing through it.

subGroups.name: Transport, Translation and Validation
subGroups.description: Moving, converting and checking every interchange.

bricks.name: Communication Gateway and Secure Transport
bricks.description: Receives and sends interchanges over the protocols partners use, encrypted in transport (Transus names TLS, AS2 and SFTP), plus Peppol access-point traffic via its e-invoicing partner. The single network connection that replaces point-to-point links.

modules.name: Interchange Ingest Endpoints
modules.description: AS2, SFTP and HTTPS endpoints per customer and partner.
Uses session.

modules.name: Inbound and Outbound Message Queue
modules.description: Durable buffer between transport and processing.

modules.name: Protocol Session and Certificate Service
modules.description: Manages AS2 certificates, SFTP keys, MDN receipts and retries.

modules.name: Network Interconnect Adapters
modules.description: Interconnects with other EDI networks and VANs used by large retailers.

brickDependencies.description: Keys and certificates from the security vault.

dataDependencies.description: Stores raw interchanges as received and sent.
Uses certificates and keys for partner sessions.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Reaching partners that use another provider.

bricks.name: Format Translation and Mapping Engine
bricks.description: Translates between each customer's in-house format (ERP export, XML, CSV, WMS format) and the partner's standard such as EDIFACT or UBL, so "we deliver our data according to our standard and Transus makes it match the retailer" (Anova Seafood case).

modules.name: Translation Worker
modules.description: Applies mappings to queued interchanges.
Uses maps.

modules.name: Syntax Converters
modules.description: Parsers and serializers for EDIFACT, UBL, XML, CSV and fixed formats.

modules.name: Mapping Repository
modules.description: Versioned mappings per customer, partner and document type.

brickDependencies.description: Consumes interchanges from the transport queue.
Target structures come from partner profiles.

dataDependencies.description: Reads source and writes translated interchanges.

bricks.name: Message Validation and Business Rules
bricks.description: Automatically blocks messages with errors before they reach the partner and raises an alert explained "in understandable language" (Hornbach news item). Checks syntax, partner profile rules and business rules such as mandatory GLNs, totals and SSCC presence.

modules.name: Validation Engine
modules.description: Runs syntax, profile and business-rule checks on each message.

modules.name: Rule Set Service
modules.description: Versioned validation rules per partner and document type.

brickDependencies.description: Partner requirements drive rules.
Failed validations raise alerts.

dataDependencies.description: Records validation failures with a plain-language reason.

bricks.name: Message Routing and Delivery Tracking
bricks.description: Routes each validated message to the right partner endpoint and records every status change, so both the customer and its trading partner can log in and see the current status of every message (Transus states partners get access even if they are not customers).

modules.name: Routing Worker
modules.description: Determines destination route and dispatches.
Uses status.

modules.name: Message Status Ledger
modules.description: Event history per message: received, translated, validated, delivered, acknowledged.

brickDependencies.description: Hands messages back to transport for delivery.
Only validated messages are routed.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for message lifecycle events.

subGroups.name: Business Documents
subGroups.description: Document-specific logic for the order-to-cash and replenishment cycle.

bricks.name: Order and Order Response Processing
bricks.description: Document logic for purchase orders (ORDERS), order changes and order responses (ORDRSP): normalising retailer orders into one structure for the supplier ERP and returning confirmations within the retailer's window.

modules.name: Order Normaliser
modules.description: Normalises retailer-specific orders to one canonical order.

modules.name: Order Document Service
modules.description: Keeps order, change and response linkage per partner.

brickDependencies.description: Uses translation mappings.

dataDependencies.description: Orders, changes and responses as exchanged.

bricks.name: Despatch Advice and SSCC Labelling
bricks.description: Creates despatch advice (DESADV) and GS1-compliant SSCC pallet labels from order and packing data, including automatic transport configuration in EDI Plus. Hornbach confirmed the Transus SSCC label meets its mandatory label requirement.

modules.name: Packing and Label Screen
modules.description: Supplier builds pallets from an order and prints SSCC labels.
Uses api.

modules.name: Despatch API
modules.description: Creates DESADV and labels from portal or ERP data.

modules.name: SSCC Numbering and Label Service
modules.description: Allocates serial shipping container codes under the supplier GS1 prefix and renders labels.

modules.name: Despatch Advice Builder
modules.description: Builds DESADV with packing hierarchy, batches and best-before dates.
Uses sscc.

brickDependencies.description: Despatch is built from the confirmed order.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: GS1 company prefix of the supplier
externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: SSCCs are built from the supplier's GS1 prefix.
Prints pallet labels at the supplier warehouse.

bricks.name: E-Invoicing and Mandate Compliance
bricks.description: Turns ERP invoices into the format each customer or authority requires: EDIFACT INVOIC for retailers and EN 16931 e-invoices in XRechnung, ZUGFeRD and Peppol, with technical handling in partnership with Tickstar. Prepares customers for German send obligations from 2027 (turnover above EUR 800,000) and 2028.

modules.name: E-Invoice Format Builder
modules.description: Builds EN 16931 compliant XRechnung, ZUGFeRD and Peppol BIS documents.

modules.name: Invoice Document Service
modules.description: Links invoices to orders and despatch, tracks acceptance and rejection.

modules.name: Peppol Access Point Adapter
modules.description: Sends and receives via the Tickstar Peppol access point.

brickDependencies.description: Invoices reference delivered quantities.
EN 16931 and partner rules checked before sending.

dataDependencies.description: Invoices and credit notes as exchanged.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Technical handling of e-invoice formats and transmission.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.system: German business customers and public buyers

bricks.name: Document Archive
bricks.description: Retains exchanged invoices and documents for audit and retrieval; listed as "archive your invoices" in the Premium plan.

modules.name: Archive Retrieval API
modules.description: Search and download archived documents.

modules.name: Archive Store Service
modules.description: Immutable, retention-managed document storage.

brickDependencies.description: Archives every sent and received invoice.

bricks.name: Vendor Managed Inventory
bricks.description: Uses retailer sales, stock and forecast messages so a supplier replenishes proactively instead of waiting for orders, as Henri van de Bilt does for Albert Heijn; results in a replenishment order and despatch advice to the retailer and its logistics provider.

modules.name: VMI Forecast Dashboard
modules.description: Shows retailer stock, forecast and proposed replenishment.
Uses plan.

modules.name: Replenishment Planner
modules.description: Calculates replenishment quantities against agreed stock levels.

brickDependencies.description: Replenishment results in a despatch advice.

dataDependencies.description: Retailer stock, sales and forecast data.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Source of stock and forecast data.

rootGroups.name: Customer Workspace and Integration
rootGroups.description: Where customers and their IT partners meet the platform: the Transus Online portal, monitoring and alerts, reporting, ERP/WMS APIs and the connectors to Katapull Commerce Hub siblings and certified partners.

subGroups.name: Portal and Visibility
subGroups.description: Web EDI, monitoring and reporting for business users without IT knowledge.

bricks.name: Transus Online Web EDI Portal
bricks.description: The online.transus.com portal for suppliers without an ERP link (Basic plan): view and process incoming orders, create confirmations, despatch advice and invoices by hand, and see message status, with validation errors explained for non-IT users.

modules.name: Document Inbox and Editor
modules.description: Lists incoming documents and lets users create responses.
Uses bff.

modules.name: Portal Backend for Frontend
modules.description: Aggregates documents, status and alerts for the portal.

brickDependencies.description: Reads orders and creates responses.
Shows message status.
Authenticates portal users.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.description: Exchange documents manually through the portal.

bricks.name: Monitoring, Alerts and Exception Resolution
bricks.description: Tracks every connection and message flow so issues are caught and resolved "before a supplier or department notices" (retailer page); alerts customers and Transus support, and gives a resolution queue.

modules.name: Exception Console
modules.description: Lists blocked or late messages with reason and next action.
Uses alerts.

modules.name: Flow Watchdog
modules.description: Detects missing, late or stuck messages against expected patterns.
Uses alerts.

modules.name: Alerting and Case Service
modules.description: Creates alerts and exception cases, notifies users by e-mail.

brickDependencies.description: Reads message status events.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Alert delivery.

bricks.name: Message Analytics and Reporting
bricks.description: Real-time insight into messages (Basic plan feature) and reporting on volumes, error rates and partner performance for customers, retailers and Transus account managers.

modules.name: Message Insight Dashboard
modules.description: Volumes, errors and lead times per partner.
Uses agg.

modules.name: Metrics Aggregation Service
modules.description: Aggregates status events into metrics.

brickDependencies.description: Uses message status events.

subGroups.name: Systems Integration
subGroups.description: APIs and connectors to ERP, WMS, accounting and commerce systems.

bricks.name: ERP and WMS API and Connector Framework
bricks.description: API-first integration with virtually any ERP or WMS, on premise or cloud (Premium plan "API connection with ERP and WMS"), plus file-based exchange (XML, CSV) for older systems. Used by certified partners such as Ecobit (AFAS), NAS conception (Microsoft Business Central app NC365) and integrators for Exact, KING, Odoo, SAP and Unit4.

modules.name: Customer Integration API
modules.description: REST API for posting and fetching business documents.

modules.name: File Drop Interface
modules.description: SFTP drop folders for XML/CSV exports from legacy ERPs.

modules.name: ERP Connector Adapters
modules.description: Reusable adapters and templates used by certified partners.

brickDependencies.description: In-house formats are mapped on entry.
API credentials and scopes.

dataDependencies.description: Integration endpoints and settings per customer.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: ERP systems (AFAS, Exact, KING, Odoo, SAP, Unit4, Business Central, NetSuite)
externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Source and target of business documents.

bricks.name: Katapull Commerce Hub Connectors
bricks.description: Ready links between Transus and sibling Katapull brands (Logic4, Vendit, Highbiza, EffectConnect, DeliveryMatch, Returnista, Picqer). Transus lists each as a Commerce Hub partner and states "each company can be connected with Transus"; connector depth per brand is not publicly documented.

modules.name: Commerce Hub Event Bridge
modules.description: Translates sibling events to Transus documents and back.

modules.name: Logic4 and Vendit ERP Connector
modules.description: Exchanges orders, despatch and invoices with Logic4 and Vendit back offices.

modules.name: DeliveryMatch, Picqer and Returnista Connector
modules.description: Shares shipment, warehouse and return data with logistics siblings.

modules.name: Highbiza and EffectConnect Connector
modules.description: Links B2B webshop and marketplace order flows to EDI.

brickDependencies.description: Built on the customer integration API.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Omnichannel ERP (sibling domain omnichannel-commerce-erp-platform).
Retail POS and back office (sibling domain retail-pos-and-store-management-platform).
Shipping and carrier management (sibling domain shipping-and-carrier-management-platform).
Returns management (sibling domain ecommerce-returns-management-platform).
B2B webshops (sibling domain b2b-wholesale-ecommerce-platform).
Marketplace integration (sibling domain marketplace-channel-integration-platform).

rootGroups.name: Platform Foundation
rootGroups.description: Subscriptions, identity, security and continuity, and the expert support that customers repeatedly cite as the reason they stay.

bricks.name: Tenant, Subscription and Plan Management
bricks.description: Customer accounts and the fixed-price plans (Basic from EUR 79, Plus from EUR 149 per month on annual terms, Premium on request; unlimited messages and partners), monthly or annual terms, online purchase and entitlements per plan.

modules.name: Plan Selection and Checkout
modules.description: Buy-now flow from the pricing page.
Uses sub.

modules.name: Subscription and Entitlement Service
modules.description: Plans, terms and feature entitlements (SSCC, API, archive, premium support).

modules.name: Billing System Adapter
modules.description: Passes subscriptions to finance for invoicing.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Recurring subscription invoicing.

bricks.name: Identity and Access Management
bricks.description: User accounts for customers, partner users and their trading partners, with least-privilege access (stated in Transus NIS2 FAQ) and API credentials.

modules.name: Authentication API
modules.description: Login, tokens and API keys.
Uses dir.

modules.name: User and Role Directory
modules.description: Users, roles and partner-scoped access.

brickDependencies.description: Access follows the tenant and plan.

subGroups.name: Trust and Service
subGroups.description: ISO 27001 controls, NIS2 assurance, continuity and the service desk.

bricks.name: Security, Compliance and Continuity
bricks.description: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS, encryption in transport, annual pentests, incident response with three emergency levels, data centres in Frankfurt with disaster recovery in Amsterdam, and a NIS2 information pack for customers' supplier assessments.

modules.name: Trust and Assurance Pack Portal
modules.description: Provides NIS2 FAQ, ISO certificate and questionnaires to customers.

modules.name: Replication and Failover Daemon
modules.description: Replicates data to the Amsterdam disaster-recovery site.

modules.name: Key and Certificate Vault
modules.description: Stores transport certificates, keys and secrets.

modules.name: Security Audit Log Service
modules.description: Tamper-evident log of access and configuration changes.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for transport credentials.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: EU data centres (Frankfurt primary, Amsterdam DR)
externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Processing and storage location.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.description: Use it in NIS2 supplier assessments.

bricks.name: EDI Expert Support and Service Desk
bricks.description: EDI specialists in Amersfoort, Antwerp and Dusseldorf supporting customers and partners in Dutch, German and English; Premium plan includes premium support. Customer cases repeatedly cite fast fixes ("Transus just picks it up and fixes it").

modules.name: Support Desk Console
modules.description: Tickets linked to messages, connections and exceptions.
Uses tickets.

modules.name: Ticket and Knowledge Service
modules.description: Tickets, SLAs per plan and known-issue knowledge base.

brickDependencies.description: Exceptions can open support tickets.
Support level depends on plan.
